purpose: Evaluator-only dataset caveats; never supplied to autonomous detection.

caveats.description: One attempt did not finish properly and was not an actual bracket match. Probably closer to the middle than the end; a larger than average gap may help locate it.
caveats.verification: Still unlocated. H.264 HLS sampling succeeded in both candidate gaps at 20-second intervals. A separate local Qwen contact-sheet diagnostic observed setup/downtime and no active gameplay in those sampled frames; this does not rule out brief missed play or establish bracket validity.
caveats.handling: Inspect long inter-set gaps and long saved cuts as label-guided diagnostics. A gap is not proof. Do not remove historical labels or exclude a prediction until the attempt is identified and verified. Keep raw historical agreement metrics.
verification_history: Unverified: public-media extraction returned HTTP 403, then a fresh-URL attempt stalled and was stopped. No bracket-status conclusion was made.

followup_diagnostics.conclusion: Still unlocated. A model claim of black frames at 5075-5079s was contradicted by pixel checks on overlapping samples (gameplay-region mean luminance about103-106/255). The one-second continuation diagnostic reported a normal round continuation. Contact-sheet model descriptions are not authoritative labels; no exclusion was added.
